notes.title: Update Notice: New Difficulty Added
notes.content: [p][b]Update Details[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new difficulty: "Hardcore"[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed several classes[/p][/*][*][p]Added new purchasable items[/p][/*][*][p]Added new hints[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor bugs & typos[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]New Difficulty: Hardcore[/b][/p][list][*][p]Becomes available after clearing the game once.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies are significantly stronger.[/p][/*][*][p]If you level up beyond the class change requirement without promoting, EXP gained will decrease.[/p][/*][*][p]In this difficulty only, Haino, Ena, Celia, Taylor, Grem, Leticia, and Marcella have their growth rates for ATK, MAG, and DEF increased by +10%.[/p][/*][*][p]As with "Normal," units reduced to 0 HP can deploy again from the next stage, and even if you are wiped out, you can retry as many times as you like while keeping EXP.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Class Buffs[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Lord Knight[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sword Dancer[/b][/p][quote][p]Already strong classes, but given the effort required to create them, they have been further strengthened.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]Rune Lancer[/b][/p][quote][p]A strong class for suitable units, but since it had a high entry barrier to reach full potential, it has been made more appealing to use.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]Bow Knight[/b][/p][quote][p]Compared to Paladin and Sniper, it was slightly underwhelming, so ATK has been increased.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]Assassin[/b][/p][quote][p]HP slightly increased.[/p][/quote][/*][/list][p][i]Note: When loading save data from previous versions, some units may appear with slightly reduced HP on the battle preparation screen due to these adjustments. This will resolve itself as you progress through the game.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]New Purchasable Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]In the later part of the game, the new item [b]"Ancient Ring"[/b] can be purchased.[/p][/*][*][p]After a total party wipe in Stage 47, additional shop items will become available (except on Expert difficulty).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Additional Hints[/b][/p][list][*][p]More hints have been added to help you progress through the game.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.balance_change: [p]In this difficulty only, Haino, Ena, Celia, Taylor, Grem, Leticia, and Marcella have their growth rates for ATK, MAG, and DEF increased by +10%.[/p]
[p]Compared to Paladin and Sniper, it was slightly underwhelming, so ATK has been increased.[/p]

tags.feature: [p]In the later part of the game, the new item [b]"Ancient Ring"[/b] can be purchased.[/p]
[p]More hints have been added to help you progress through the game.[/p]

notes.title: Update & Bug Fix Notice
notes.content: [p]・You can disable the automatic save window at the beginning of each turn by turning off "Turn Start Save Prompt" in the "Settings" menu.[/p][p]・Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, some characters' epilogues would not play correctly during the ending.[/p][p]・Corrected a graphical error in the MVP character display at the ending.[/p]

tags.feature: ・You can disable the automatic save window at the beginning of each turn by turning off "Turn Start Save Prompt" in the "Settings" menu.

tags.bug: ・Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, some characters' epilogues would not play correctly during the ending.
・Corrected a graphical error in the MVP character display at the ending.

notes.title: Update & Bug Fix Notice
notes.content: [list][*][p]Physical attack classes will no longer randomly receive Magic stat increases.[/p][/*][*][p]Magic attack classes will no longer randomly receive Strength stat increases.[/p][/*][*][p]Civilians will still be able to increase both stats as before.[/p][/*][*][p]Between July 24 and July 26, there was a bug affecting stat growth rate calculations. This has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bugs such as typos have also been corrected.[/p][/*][/list]
